title: Operations + More / Secondary Management Design Remediation

notes: Implements UI-06 from issue #94 using the approved Kairo design baseline and shared product shell.
Operations becomes task-first: failures and operator judgment precede cost, automation and audit detail.
More becomes the coherent mobile/secondary-management hub without expanding Kairo primary navigation.
Existing retry, disable-automation, authorization, audit and redaction contracts remain unchanged.
Vercel Git-triggered deployment remains disabled and this slice has no deployment approval.

approvals.rationale: Owner instructed Go next, authorizing UI-06 Operations + More / secondary management as the next bounded Kairo remediation slice.
This slice preserves FR-20 control semantics and approved web/mobile IA without adding operator capabilities or policy.
Go next authorizes bounded implementation, tests, UI review and exact-head certification gates. Merge and deployment remain separate approvals.
Requires implementation-level UI Review plus Product Intake, Security baseline and CI on one frozen exact candidate SHA.
Separate exact-SHA release approval is required.

postRelease.expectedOutcome: Operators see exceptions before diagnostics, while users reach secondary Brand/management work from one calm More hierarchy.
